verdict.rationale: AutoGen's extension install pattern (`autogen-ext[openai]`) and AssistantAgent's model-client abstraction imply a pluggable model-client design that could support swapping providers, but the evidence pack never shows a documented example of switching model clients (e.g., OpenAI to Azure/Anthropic) without code changes. missing for 10: explicit docs/example demonstrating swapping model providers, list of supported model client extensions, and independent confirmation this works in practice.
